recipe.name: Homemade by Bekah: S'mores Cookies
recipe.description: Angie's S'mores Cookies adapted as a finalized working version after the first batch: visible half-marshmallow on top, chocolate rectangle added after baking. New assembly untested.
recipe.source: Angie's S'mores Cookies (TikTok) adapted by Bekah, as transcribed in user-supplied finalized working recipe, 2026-11-22; Boston Girl Bakes image linked for illustration only.

ingredients.name: Large marshmallows
ingredients.preparation: cut in half, 12 halves total; one half per cookie

steps.instruction: Beat softened butter, packed light brown sugar, and granulated sugar together for 2 to 3 minutes until creamy.
Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla extract. Mix until combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, finely crushed graham crackers, baking powder, baking soda, and fine sea salt.
Gradually incorporate the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients.
Fold in the mini chocolate chips.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions and refrigerate for approximately 1 hour.
Flatten each chilled dough portion into a thick disc.
Place one graham cracker piece and one milk chocolate piece in the center of each dough disc.
Place half a large marshmallow on top of the chocolate in each cookie.
Fold the dough around the filling, sealing the bottom and sides.
Leave a small opening at the top so some marshmallow is visible. Do not make a hole through the bottom.
Keep the dough relatively thick, but flatten the assembled cookie slightly.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 12 minutes, checking that the edges are lightly golden and the centers are no longer visibly raw.
Remove from the oven and immediately press one Hershey's milk chocolate rectangle onto each cookie.
Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before transferring.

recipe.notes: Chill 1 hour; bake at 350°F for approximately 12 minutes; cool on baking sheet for 10 minutes. Some exposed marshmallow may soften, expand or spread during baking. Add Hershey's milk chocolate rectangle AFTER baking for recognizable shape. If cookies spread unevenly, optionally round edges immediately after baking with a circular cookie cutter. Optional extra mini marshmallows: quantity and timing not confirmed. The visible marshmallow and chocolate should identify cookies as s'mores without cutting them open. First batch fully enclosed the marshmallow; revised opening at top and reduced marshmallow amount have not yet been tested, so final appearance is unconfirmed.
